policies.title: Burkinabè ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule places Burkina Faso in its Prior to Arrival cohort, requiring a visa from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Burkinabè passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this classification.

policies.title: Burkinabè ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places Burkina Faso in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless the separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Burkinabè passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the authorized-visa application and listed documents before travel to the competent Panamanian consulate; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted and carry all required supporting documents.

policies.title: Burkinabè ordinary passports: Mongolia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's official general rule requires a mission application for nationals outside the listed exemption and eVisa cohorts; Burkina Faso is in neither current closed list.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Burkinabè passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Apply for the appropriate visitor visa through a Mongolian diplomatic mission before travel.
This conclusion combines Mongolia's stated general rule with its current closed exemption and eVisa lists; it does not infer a special-document or invitation route.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and exceptional on-arrival routes remain outside scope.

application.label: Mongolia general visitor-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Normally 3 working days; some applications may require 5–10 working days.
steps: Confirm that no listed visa exemption or eVisa eligibility applies.
Submit the temporary-visitor application and supporting documents at the nearest Mongolian diplomatic mission.
Obtain the visa before travelling to Mongolia.
